notes.title: MORE updates!
notes.content:
We've once again done a lot of debugging and brought out the broom and swept away some annoying issues.

Issues that should be fixed now:
- "E" button press. Fixed issues with picking up elves and pressing buttons. (Somehow the "E" meme hit us with a resurgence).
- Respawning when falling out of world should be cleaned up.
- No more stuff spawning and falling through the storage room floor.
- Wood cutting area destructibles actually destroying with ground pound attack.
- Mouse doesn't lock after a game.
We're also in the progress of fixing lighting and similar issues that requires some time and computer power. We're playing the waiting game now :O

Now hopefully the game will feel smooth enough to end this god damn Christmas!

P.s: Running the game on ultra might actually be quite demanding on your computer. These Elf physics are no joking matter!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460814/d621e589a9d9583093f39a4d51df72788f855be8.png[/img]
